label: Subject-relative reliability assessment and warrant transmission
term: Subject-relative reliability assessment and warrant transmission
definition: A profile supplies subjects, contents and evidence bases. Independent predicates record acceptance, assessing reliability as low, inability to assess reliability, supporting a content, undercutting a basis for the subject, warrant, and truth. Undefeated support is support from at least one basis that is not undercut.
note: Analyst formal vocabulary, attribution deferred. Low assessment and inability to assess are separate epistemic inputs, neither is an actual probability or assertion of objective unreliability. An undercutter removes a route to support, and need not support the negation of the content. No global defeat, monotonicity or completeness of the basis roster is assumed. An independent reason can keep warrant in place when the tested basis is undercut.
